title: Spam filter: Unicode normalisation neutralises invisible-character insertion

invariants.description: Inserting zero-width characters (the rendered message is visually unchanged) must still evade the undefended filter (observed 41/93 = 44.1%).
Every adversarial message must satisfy every declared text-preservation constraint (re-validated from the stored text and edit script).
A NEW attack restricted to invisible characters must not evade a filter that strips format characters (observed 0/93).
The reduction on the same messages must be significant.

rationale: The unicode step removes every character the 'invisible' charset can produce, so no search within that charset can succeed. The claim is scoped: it says nothing about ASCII edits (see MLB-REG-009/010).
